What this course is not

This is not a federal grants course. We focus on private foundation and corporate grants — the proposals that development coordinators at small and mid-sized nonprofits write most often. Federal RFPs involve a different compliance and formatting language that would require its own dedicated course to do justice.

Refund policy

Full refunds are available until one week before the course starts (September 3). After that date, refunds are not available — but your enrollment can be transferred to the next available cohort at no additional charge. Questions? Email us before enrolling.

Scholarship seats

Each cohort includes three fully subsidized scholarship seats for grassroots organizations with annual budgets under $500,000. Scholarship recipients receive full access to the course at no cost.

We prioritize organizations led by and serving communities that have historically been underserved by private philanthropy — including BIPOC-led organizations, rural nonprofits, and organizations working in geographic areas with limited local foundation support.

To apply, check the scholarship box on the enrollment form and describe your organization briefly. We review applications on a rolling basis and respond within five business days.
